Teach English online with Move Up Academy

GuroPrep is made by the team behind Move Up Academy, an English school with a campus in Cebu and online learners in China. We are looking for Filipino teachers who enjoy teaching and want extra income from home.

What the work is like

  • One-on-one English classes online (25 or 40 minutes), using Tencent Meeting.
  • Learners are students in China. China is in the same time zone as the Philippines, and many classes are after school: often in the evening and on weekends.
  • You keep regular learners at fixed times, so your schedule is stable.
  • Lesson materials and an AI homework system are provided. You focus on teaching.
  • Classes are scheduled outside your school hours. If you work in a public school, please follow your school's rules on outside work.

Who we are looking for

  • Clear, friendly spoken English and patience with learners
  • Teaching experience (school or online) is a plus, but not required
  • A computer or laptop, headset, and stable internet at home

Apply in 3 minutes

We will contact you by email or mobile for a short interview and demo class.

Applying does not affect your use of GuroPrep. GuroPrep stays free for all teachers.
